Class Iti104AuditDataset

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.core.atna.AuditDataset
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.audit.FhirAuditDataset
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.iti104.Iti104AuditDataset
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Iti104AuditDataset extends FhirAuditDataset
Audit dataset of the Patient Identity Feed FHIR [ITI-104] transaction. The identifier of the patient is kept as FHIR token in FhirAuditDataset.getPatientIds().
